# Salesforce Enterprise Patterns

> Implement and enforce the Aleysian house Salesforce architecture on a project codebase - service layer shared by trigger, UI, and API entry points, a lean owned UnitOfWork for all DML, selector classes with USER_MODE for all SOQL, DTO returns from AuraEnabled controllers, and imperative Apex from LWC - with a tested PMD 7 ruleset, an ESLint rule, and an arch_check orchestrator that adds warn/block policy, legacy-path downgrades, and suppression-reason governance.

**What it does.** Implement and enforce the Aleysian house Salesforce architecture: service layer shared by trigger/UI/API entry points, a lean owned Unit of Work for all DML, selector classes for all SOQL (USER_MODE by default), DTO/POJO returns from @AuraEnabled controllers, and imperative Apex from LWC.

**Use it when.** Writing or reviewing Apex classes, triggers, LWC JavaScript, or scaffolding a new Salesforce feature — even if the user doesn't name the architecture. Also use it when asked to set up pre-commit checks, run architecture checks, fix arch-check violations, add a selector/service/UoW, or bring legacy Apex toward the house pattern.
